message:
testing: ignore Cython's PyPy collection_type warning (#15096)

PyPy 3.11.16 (PyPy 8.0.0) makes Cython-compiled numpy.random emit
'cython.collection_type only works on PyPy with the C flag
CYTHON_USE_TYPE_SPECS=1' as a RuntimeWarning on import. hypothesis
imports numpy.random whenever numpy is loaded, so under
filterwarnings=error every @given test fails on the pypy3-xdist job.
Same numpy 2.4.6 and hypothesis 6.168.1 import cleanly on PyPy 3.11.15.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
